episode_summary: cbrech drops the week's high score on Cwmessi in a 96.66-point demolition, while rfrancella97 steals an upset from JoshWileczek, who left the winning points on his bench. Doc and Vinny break down the rookies and breakouts to watch, and the trade deadline arrives right now with a messy race for the 6 seed.

lines.speaker: vinny
lines.text: 96.66. That is the margin cbrech beat Cwmessi by this week. That's not a matchup, that's a hostage situation.

lines.speaker: doc
lines.text: cbrech posted 174.92, the high score of the week. Cwmessi posted 78.26, the low score of the week. Same game. Jahmyr Gibbs alone had 40.7.

lines.speaker: vinny
lines.text: And Cwmessi left 38.6 on the bench! Rookie Josh Cameron scores 14.2 sitting down, and Omar Cooper Jr. starts and scores 0.0.

lines.speaker: doc
lines.text: To be fair, his optimal lineup was 116.86. That still loses comfortably. The bench wasn't the problem, it was the garnish.

lines.speaker: vinny
lines.text: That's ten straight head-to-head losses. Cwmessi, buddy, I love you, but whatever app you're setting lineups on is lying to you.

lines.speaker: doc
lines.text: Welcome to SEPA Dynasty Weekly. I'm Doc.

lines.speaker: vinny
lines.text: And I'm Vinny, and I'm already yelling.

lines.speaker: doc
lines.text: The real story was the upset. rfrancella97, ninth in the power rankings, beat JoshWileczek, ranked third, 126.86 to 123.3. A margin of 3.56.

lines.speaker: vinny
lines.text: And Josh handed it to him! Kirk Cousins on the bench with 15.38, Bryce Young starting with 8.1. That's my bench blunder of the week, because it cost a game.

lines.speaker: doc
lines.text: JoshWileczek's optimal lineup would have won. He left 16.58 on the bench and lost by 3.56. The math is not complicated.

lines.speaker: vinny
lines.text: And the funny part? rfrancella97 wins and still loses to the median. 126.86 doesn't clear 131.15. He won the raffle and got a coupon.

lines.speaker: doc
lines.text: Very on brand. rfrancella97 is 6-4 head-to-head and 2-8 against the median. Lucky or clutch, depending on who you ask.

lines.speaker: vinny
lines.text: Meanwhile Djax818 is on a W8. Christian McCaffrey drops 44.3. Nobody can stop this man.

lines.speaker: doc
lines.text: And he did it with 28.68 on his own bench. DJ Moore sat with 17.4 while Chris Olave started with 4.5.

lines.speaker: vinny
lines.text: He's winning with a handicap. It's disrespectful to the rest of us.

lines.speaker: doc
lines.text: Which brings us to the watch list. stehr's rookie Emmett Johnson, drafted at 3.04, gets his first start in this league and scores 32.1. He'd averaged 6.73 before.

lines.speaker: vinny
lines.text: Third round! stehr's strutting around like a genius. But I saw you bench Deebo Samuel Sr. for 24.4 while Malik Nabers gave you 4.9. You won by 66.58, stehr, and I still saw it.

lines.speaker: doc
lines.text: Next, Fernando Mendoza. JoshWileczek took him at 1.04. 13.92 points this week, on the bench, after averaging 2.22.

lines.speaker: vinny
lines.text: So Josh had Cousins on the bench, Mendoza on the bench, and started Bryce Young. Three doors, and he picked the one with the goat behind it.

lines.speaker: doc
lines.text: In fairness, his other new starter, Drew Lock, gave him 15.6. That quarterback room isn't empty. It's just hard to read, and he needs to read it before next week.

lines.speaker: doc
lines.text: Blake Corum for Djax818. First start in this league, 19.4 points, prior average 9.96. The rich get richer.

lines.speaker: vinny
lines.text: Of course they do. Now Mark Andrews. cbrech benched him with 16.2 and started Rhamondre Stevenson, who scored 1.0. One point!

lines.speaker: doc
lines.text: Andrews had averaged 6.52, so I understand the hesitation. But cbrech still left 25.82 on the bench in the biggest blowout of the week.

lines.speaker: vinny
lines.text: And hogantim97, listen to this. Omarion Hampton, 17.0 points, prior average 7.84. Who'd he trade for him with? stehr. Who drafted him at 1.02? stehr. Revenge game energy.

lines.speaker: doc
lines.text: Add his own rookie, Jordyn Tyson, taken 1.05. First start, 13.5 points after averaging 3.0. hogantim97 has quietly won two straight.

lines.speaker: doc
lines.text: No trades this week. But the deadline is week 11. As in, right now.

lines.speaker: vinny
lines.text: Right now! kingdemi, you're sixth at 10-10, go buy something. aaronyuhas, three straight losses, sell. And Cwmessi, you've got rookie Seth McGowan with 13.7 on your bench and his value up 443 in 30 days. Sell high to a contender.

lines.speaker: doc
lines.text: Quick standings. Six playoff spots, two byes, 4 weeks left, and records include the median game. Djax818 has clinched. Cwmessi is eliminated.

lines.speaker: vinny
lines.text: The race is the 6 seed. kingdemi sits there at 10-10, rfrancella97 is 2 wins back, hogantim97 is 3 back.

lines.speaker: doc
lines.text: And next week kingdemi plays rfrancella97 head-to-head. If rfrancella97 also beats the median for once, that gap gets very small.

lines.speaker: vinny
lines.text: Also, JoshWileczek's last three weeks average 122.63. Third seed, sliding. Josh, get nervous.

lines.speaker: doc
lines.text: Next week's marquee: Djax818 against cbrech, the 1 seed against the 2 seed. The form guide favors Djax818 by 3.79.

lines.speaker: vinny
lines.text: I'm taking cbrech. You just watched him drop 174.92. The W8 stops at 8, I'm calling it now.

lines.speaker: doc
lines.text: I'll take Djax818. Per my earlier point, he won this week with 28.68 on his bench. Imagine if he sets a lineup.

lines.speaker: vinny
lines.text: Fine, but when cbrech wins, I want it on the record. Deadline's this week, everybody, make a move.

lines.speaker: doc
lines.text: That's SEPA Dynasty Weekly. Check your benches. We certainly will.

fact_check.verdict: Every line matches the facts; no corrections needed.
